attribution: The World Bank: Climate Change Knowledge Portal: Observed Climate Data, ERA5 0.25-Degree (doi:10.57966/128g-6s70): Copernicus Climate Change Service ERA5. The World Bank: Climate Change Knowledge Portal: Projected Climate Data, CMIP6 0.25-Degree (doi:10.57966/b54h-7s87): CMIP6 multi-model ensemble (World Climate Research Programme).
description: Longest dry spell of the year, 1995–2014 as the models simulate it and projected for 2020–2039, 2040–2059, 2060–2079 and 2080–2099 under low, middle and very high emissions, for every country and territory, from the CMIP6 climate models as bias-corrected, downscaled and aggregated by the World Bank's Climate Change Knowledge Portal. Each value is averaged over the land of the place, not weighted by where people live. The value is the median of the models and the range runs from the 10th to the 90th percentile of the models. The 1995–2014 values are the models' simulation of the recent past, not observations.

processing.description: Read CCKP's 39 CMIP6 0.25° all_countries_subnationals files of cdd (climatology): the multi-model ensemble median, 10th and 90th percentiles for the 1995–2014 historical runs and 2020–2039, 2040–2059, 2060–2079 and 2080–2099 under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. Every file holds the same 246 countries and 3,529 regions.

Checked every country's value against its own regions' values in the same file: within the lowest and highest region (±0.01, rounding), or equal to its one region. Declared exceptions, whose national values are published as CCKP prints them, each allowed to lie at most 1.53 days outside its regions' range: 19 countries (BEL, BES, BHR, BIH, BLR, CYM, DNK, FIN, GGY, JEY, KWT, LIE, LTU, LUX, NLD, QAT, SPM, VCT, VIR, CCKP's codes). In these files 46 of their values lie outside, 21 below the lowest region and 25 above the highest, by up to 1.53 days (QAT, ssp126 2020 p90: 252.88 against 254.41 to 261.66). That fits how CCKP describes its ensemble, "calculated from the individual model series": if each area's median and percentiles are taken over the models' own values for that area, a country's median need not lie between the medians of its regions, by a little and either way.

Published every country and territory (246), mapping CCKP's codes to the site's entities (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes as they are, KSV, CCKP's code for Kosovo, as KOS): the median as the value and the 10th and 90th percentiles as the range, as printed, with the 20-year window as the period and the emissions scenario as a dimension.

scope.basis: CMIP6 multi-model ensemble (bias-corrected and downscaled to 0.25° by CCKP): the median of the models, with their 10th–90th percentile as the range. The year's longest run of consecutive dry days, days with less than 1 mm of precipitation (CCKP's cdd), averaged over the 20 years. A dry spell, not a drought. 20-year averages: 1995–2014 from the historical runs; 2020–2039, 2040–2059, 2060–2079 and 2080–2099 under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5. Projections, not forecasts of any one year.
scope.geography: Each country or territory as drawn by the World Bank's official boundaries: the area-weighted mean of the 0.25° grid cells inside it, averaged over the land, not weighted by where people live. No world value.

title: Longest dry spell of the year by country, projected for 20-year windows to 2099 (CMIP6, World Bank CCKP)

unit.label: days in the year's longest run of days with less than 1 mm of precipitation
